HOW IT WORKS:

WHY USE WINSYNC:
Friendly contests are more fun when there's something on the line, but the worst part has always been collecting afterward. Someone forgets. Someone ghosts the payment request. FLOAT — EFFORTLESS SOCIAL COORDINATION
Social media connected us—but it also pulled us away from real, in-person relationships. Float brings connection back to the real world.
Float is a social app for effortless, real-world activities. It helps you spend time with people—whether they’re friends you already know or new people nearby—without the pressure, performance, or planning fatigue of traditional social platforms.
Instead of endless group chats or formal events, Float lets you float activities: ideas like coffee, a walk, studying, a workout, dinner, volunteering, or a planned outing. Activities can be casual or structured, last-minute or planned ahead. If people are invited and join, the activity gains momentum. If not, it fades away.

HOW FLOAT WORKS
• Float an activity in seconds
• Invitees can see who else is invited

FOR FRIENDS AND NEW CONNECTIONS
Float works whether you’re:
• Making plans with existing friends
• Looking to meet new people in your area
• New to a city, campus, or community
• Organizing something casual, planned, or community-focused
It’s designed for real-world connection that feels natural, flexible, and low-stakes.

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
Float looks familiar, but it works differently. Activities appear in a scrollable feed so they’re easy to discover, but Float isn’t designed to keep you scrolling. It’s designed to encourage real-world connection—helping you notice something, join when it feels right, and then put your phone away. Float values presence over performance, while leaving space to remember meaningful moments in a way that feels natural and pressure-free.

OUR PHILOSOPHY
Everyone deserves real social connection—without needing to be popular, loud, or well-connected. Float puts the power to gather in anyone’s hands. Anyone can float an activity, invite others, or show up—whether it’s with close friends, new people, or the broader community. Connection shouldn’t depend on social capital or performance. Float is built to make it easier to spend time together, support the community, and show up in the real world.

Write down what you think will happen, say how sure you are, pick the day it settles, and lock it. No edits. No quiet deletions. No rewriting history after the fact. When the day comes, you grade yourself: right, wrong, or void.

Do that ten times and Foretold shows you the number almost nobody ever sees: your calibration. "When you say 73%, you're right 55% of the time." It's a little confronting, and then it makes you better: at forecasts, at plans, at knowing when to hedge and when to commit.

HOW A CALL WORKS
One sentence, up to 200 characters. A confidence between 50% and 99% on a slider. A resolve-by date, and a category. Then a screen that restates exactly what you're locking, because after that the only thing you can do to it is grade it.

DUELS: PREDICT WITH FRIENDS, HEAD TO HEAD
Think a friend is wrong? Make it official. Send them an eight-character code. Both of you pick a side and a confidence, and neither can see the other's call until both have committed. When it settles you each file a verdict on the claim itself: agree and it resolves cleanly, disagree and it's recorded as a split. Your record sticks around. Duels are free for everyone, always, and there is no feed, no discovery and no way to see a duel you weren't given the code for.

WHY KEEP A PREDICTION JOURNAL
Most people think they're well-calibrated and have never actually checked. A prediction journal is the only honest way to find out: write the call down before you know the answer, grade it after, and let the pattern across dozens of calls tell you something your gut can't. Foretold is that journal, plus the friend who keeps you honest about it.

WHO PLAYS FORETOLD
People who make a lot of calls and want to know if they're actually good at it: "the market drops before Friday," "this launch slips," "the trade goes through." Friend groups who argue about sports, elections or office gossip and want the argument settled instead of re-litigated. Anyone who's ever said "I called it" and wanted a record to prove it.

CALIBRATION, NOT JUST A WIN RATE
Getting a call right at 51% confidence and a call right at 95% confidence shouldn't count the same, and in most places they do. Foretold's calibration curve is what actually tells you whether your confidence means anything: whether your 90% really happens nine times out of ten, or you're just saying numbers.

SideAction is the ultimate social challenge platform designed to bring excitement to your inner circle’s friendly competitions. SideAction allows you to create, track, and manage custom wagers using a virtual credit system. Whether you’re on the golf course, work, a night out on the town our app turns every moment into a high-stakes social event. By moving away from traditional betting models, SideAction focuses on the social agreement, allowing you to challenge friends directly in a transparent, peer-to-peer environment where the terms are set by you, not a house.

The heart of the SideAction experience is our dual-approval integrity system, which ensures every wager is honest and fair. Unlike traditional platforms where a central authority dictates outcomes, SideAction requires both the creator and the participants to agree on the odds and the final result. When you challenge a friend to a bet, it remains in a "Pending" state until they review and approve the terms. This mutual handshake logic prevents disputes and ensures that every win is earned through transparent agreement. To further maintain fairness, creators must set specific Betting Windows for every event. This ensures that all action is locked in before a competition begins—such as closing all wagers before a 1:00 PM tee-time—preventing "past-posting" and maintaining the integrity of the game.

To maintain a healthy social ecosystem and prevent exploitable behavior, we have implemented strict algorithmic caps on all wagering activity. By limiting single-bet odds to +400 and parlay odds to +1000, we ensure that the platform remains focused on realistic, skill-based outcomes. These safeguards, combined with a maximum wager limit (500c), keep the competition friendly and balanced. Our system is designed to prevent the accumulation of unrealistic credit balances, ensuring the leaderboard stays competitive for everyone.

The app offers various ways to play, starting with the custom New Bet feature. This allows you to set odds on literally anything, from poker night results to how many points your buddy will score in a rec basketball league. To increase the excitement, our Parlay builder lets you string together up to four different outcomes for a higher credit payout. If you prefer a direct rivalry, the Side Bet feature allows you to act as the "house" against a friend, putting your own credits on the line to back your claims. All of this can be organized within private Clubs, where you can host exclusive leaderboards and track the long-term standings of your specific group.

SideAction is perfectly suited for the everyday moments that deserve a little extra "action." Use it to see if your Friday meeting actually ends on time, or to challenge your golf buddies if they can score over/under 89.5. Because you define the "Outcome," the possibilities are limited only by your group’s imagination. Our real-time notification system keeps you updated the moment a friend challenges you or a result is settled, ensuring you never miss a beat of the competition.

SideAction is strictly a social competition platform. All wagers are placed using virtual Credits that are earned or purchased via Apple’s In-App Purchase system. These Credits have no cash value and cannot be withdrawn, cashed out, or exchanged for real-world currency or goods. By removing financial risk and focusing on social reward and mutual approval, SideAction provides a safe, fun, and compliant environment for friends to challenge each other.

start a round and send it to your five, one link each or one link in the group chat. they answer twelve questions about you and never make an account to do it. about two minutes each.

a name for who you actually are. the traits your five agreed on, with the percentages. your fatal flaw. your reputation, in one sentence. your natural habitat. the hours you are most dangerous between.

results.description:
Meet people near you through activities you enjoy.

Joiniee helps you discover local activities, join other people's plans, and create your own. From a coffee or an after-work walk to a shared hobby, turn something you want to do into an opportunity to meet someone new.

New to the city? Looking to expand your social circle? Or simply want company for something you enjoy? Start with a plan and people who want to take part.

DISCOVER ACTIVITIES NEAR YOU
Explore what people are planning around you. Read activity details, check the time and location, and find something that fits your day. With location permission, Joiniee can help you discover activities nearby.

CREATE YOUR OWN ACTIVITY
Have something in mind? Give your activity a title, describe the plan, choose a location and time, and set the number of participants. Whether it is a weekend walk, a coffee break or time for a favourite hobby, your idea can give others a reason to get together.

JOIN AND TAKE PART
Find an activity that interests you, review the details and join. If your plans change, you can leave the activity. Join someone else's plan today and create your own next time.

KEEP UP WITH YOUR PLANS
Receive updates about activities you create or join, helping you stay informed as your plans take shape.

FIND MORE REASONS TO GET TOGETHER
You might use Joiniee to:
- Find company for a walk, coffee, or workout.
- Meet people who enjoy similar activities.
- Make time for a hobby with others.
- Bring people together around a simple idea.
- Build new connections when you move to a city.
- Get more involved in your local community.

LET CONNECTION START WITH AN ACTIVITY
A shared activity gives you something to do together and a natural place to start a conversation. You do not need an elaborate event or a special occasion. Everyday plans can create opportunities to get to know someone new.

Joiniee grows through the people who take part. Every activity you create gives someone another opportunity to join in. Be considerate, respect others, and help make each shared experience welcoming.

Find something you want to do, and people to do it with.

Discover. Create. Join.

Do you ever feel like staying close with your friends is more difficult than it should be? TimeToMeet is a friendship app built to help you coordinate with your best friends, so you can go city exploring, enjoy free shows, or plan an easy diner meetup—without doing all the planning work. 

How It Works


1. Set Your Availability
Mark your free time—whether it’s for a spontaneous going out plan or a pre-arranged weekend meetup.


2. Pick Your Interests
From cultural outings to outdoorcy fun, tell us what you and your friends enjoy. We’ll suggest relevant events like free shows or local entertainment spots.

3. Swipe & Match
Get a personalized, swipable list of events that fit your schedule. Swipe on events and friends—if you both match, it’s a plan! Easily book and meet up.

4. Book Tickets Easily
You can grab event tickets through our partner ticket apps links—no more scrambling for a last-minute seat.

5. Hang Out & Stay Connected

Strengthen Real Bonds

Stay connected with with your friends with minimal effort. Share your availability, decide if you’re up for a bigger entertainment experience or just a laid-back activity at a café, and stay in sync with everyone’s schedules. No shallow matches—just real-life buddies, real free time, and new shared experiences that bring you closer.

Plan Events & Activities
Browse local events, shows, or casual outings that fit your free time, whether you’re craving an outdoorcy adventure or a quick bite. You can even plan to eat or schedule a fun buddy hangout with event tickets secured via partner ticket apps—making it simple to get together.

Make every outing a chance to bond, explore, and have fun—all with the people already in your life. It’s time to meet!
